note: G35: Relation-specific adaptive calibration & predicate clustering on FB15k-237

controls.name: C1_planted_composition_upper_bound
controls.must_fire_because: a rule engine with valid inference must achieve MRR=1.0 on a planted composition
controls.can_fail_because: inference walk could miss multi-hop paths or fail filter verification
controls.null_must_contain: an unpredicted or incorrectly ranked query on a deterministic planted relation

controls.name: C2_empty_rule_lower_bound
controls.must_fire_because: an empty rule set must yield zero hits and MRR near random entity expectation
controls.can_fail_because: tie-breaking bug could assign rank 1 to unpredicted entities
controls.null_must_contain: non-zero hits when zero rules are provided

controls.name: C3_metric_monotonicity
controls.must_fire_because: Hits@1 <= Hits@3 <= Hits@10 must strictly hold across all models
controls.can_fail_because: metric calculation bug across different thresholds
controls.null_must_contain: a strict violation of Hits@K monotonicity

controls.name: C4_strict_additivity
controls.must_fire_because: combined rule system must strictly exceed individual sub-models on Filtered MRR
controls.can_fail_because: rule conflict or confidence calibration degradation
controls.null_must_contain: combined system scoring lower MRR than baseline

falsifiers.name: F1_g35_lift_over_g34
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Full G35 fails to improve Filtered MRR by at least +0.0050 over G34 baseline
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a marginal or zero MRR gain from G35 calibration
falsifiers.refutes: Relation-specific calibration and clustering provide significant link prediction gains over static G34
falsifiers.fires_when: Full G35 fails to improve Filtered MRR by at least +0.0050 over G34 baseline
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_hits1_precision_lift
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Full G35 fails to improve Hits@1 by at least +10% relative over G34
falsifiers.refutes: Calibrated soft combination substantially improves top-1 link prediction precision over max scoring
falsifiers.fires_when: Full G35 fails to improve Hits@1 by at least +10% relative over G34
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_super_additivity
falsifiers.can_fail_because: G35 full system fails to exceed G34 and G17+L1 on Filtered MRR
falsifiers.null_must_contain: sub-model achieving higher MRR than G35 full system
falsifiers.refutes: G35 full calibrated system strictly improves over all individual sub-models
falsifiers.fires_when: G35 full system fails to exceed G34 and G17+L1 on Filtered MRR
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: Full G35 fails to improve Filtered MRR by +0.0050 over G34, fails +10% relative Hits@1 lift, or fails super-additivity
